profile.headline: Independent Software Engineer
profile.summary: Web developer focusing on front-end technologies and implementation of responsive and cross-platform web applications.

positions.title: Independent Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and development of web projects. Specializing in front end development, usability and responsive sites.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built modern full stack JavaScript and TypeScript applications with an emphasis on high-performance and sustainability.

positions.title: Paramedic Specialist
positions.description: Respond to emergency calls to provide efficient and immediate care to critically ill or injured, and transport the patient to a medical facility.

positions.title: Critical Care Paramedic
positions.description: As a part-time paramedic for the city of West Des Moines, I am provided the opportunity to provide emergency medical services to those in my community and throughout the state of Iowa.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Web Developer Consultant for ClearanceJobs.com, a niche job board dedicated to security clearance jobs. I was initially brought in to implement a redesign of the Clearance Jobs News site at https://news.clearancejobs.com. Following this project, I transitioned to the main ClearanceJobs.com site as part of a large-scale redesign and refactoring of the property.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As a Software Engineer for Pongr, I focus primarily on front-end development. Emphasis is placed on standards-based, semantic markup and cross-browser functionality for an email/MMS-based photo marketing campaign platform.

positions.title: Web Design Specialist
positions.description: While at Meredith, I functioned as part of front-end development team supporting Meredith's properties. Projects ranged from standalone micro-sites for advertising partners to implementation of full redesigns for FamilyCircle.com, LHJ.com, Parents.com and numerous others. I also had the opportunity to work on a number of interactive web applications utilizing the latest web technologies.
